choice.basis: The 'Units Sold by Product (Weekend Pop-up)' dashboard shows Product A with a bar height significantly below the 10,000 unit mark, appearing to be approximately 8,000-9,000 units. According to the 'Merchandising policy levels' table, a unit count of '< 4,000 units' triggers the 'Urgent sales intervention level'. While the visual estimate is slightly above 4,000, it is the lowest performing product by a wide margin and falls into the lowest tier of the provided options. The next tier up is '>= 4,000 and < 9,000 units' which maps to 'Low-demand review'. Given the bar is clearly below the 10,000 line and looks closer to 8,000, it fits the 'Low-demand review' criteria best among the specific numerical bands provided, unless it is strictly under 4,000. Visually, it is not under 4,000 (which would be less than half the 10,000 mark). It sits between 4,000 and 9,000.
